releases.title: Advanced statistics, probabilities and time series

releases.title: Advanced numerics, tensors and precision

releases.title: Composed calculation, autodiff and mathematical representation

releases.title: Math 2.0 integrated qualification and distribution

requirements.title: Current source, API and evidence inventory
requirements.acceptance: Reconcile public API and project/dependency roster to pinned assemblies and source; identify existing reusable tools, stale documentation and live vs historical validators; no new test/coverage claims without evidence.

requirements.title: Quality and benchmark laboratory
requirements.acceptance: Run controlled baseline on identified SDK/RID/CPU with bounded datasets and repeatability; report uncertainty and actual coverage/branch evidence; demonstrate a deliberately failing oracle and no change to runtime packages.

requirements.title: Compatibility, budgets and documentation consolidation
requirements.acceptance: Historical API and exact golden fingerprints unchanged; explicit approximate error budgets, negative limit/overflow cases, public API diff and scoped documentation/qualification consistency; no global loosened bounds.

requirements.title: Exact rational and parsing hot paths
requirements.acceptance: Independent rational and round-trip oracles, pathological length and allocation benchmarks, exact legacy error/replay equality; admit only justified changes.

requirements.title: Numerical and statistical kernels
requirements.acceptance: Test exact/approximate parity, signed zero, NaN/refusal, cancellation and floating order policies across representative sizes; compare throughput and allocation to baseline.

requirements.title: IR, codecs and language modernization
requirements.acceptance: Existing math-ir/1 canonical bytes, hashes, SplitMix64 vectors, serialization and public compatibility unchanged; independent version-pinned experiments for unsupported or speculative APIs.

requirements.title: AOT, trimming and modernized baseline gate
requirements.acceptance: Focused and historical fragile regressions precede broad boundary validation; compare benchmark evidence and source/package identity; no untested-platform or unsupported-feature claim.

requirements.title: M8 reuse and protocol authority
requirements.acceptance: Compare actual sources and immutable package metadata, prove existing IDs and historical bundles unchanged; record owner boundary, version decision and unresolved downstream facts.

requirements.title: Safe full API introspection
requirements.acceptance: Independent assembly roster and synthetic fixture with overloaded, inherited, unsupported and malformed cases; exact classification completeness, deterministic order and source/binary drift refusals.

requirements.title: Semantic attributes and normalized registry
requirements.acceptance: Positive and negative descriptor fixtures, duplicate ID/ambiguity/refusal tests, explicit documented-only/excluded/pending categories and stable IDs; no inferred permissions.

requirements.title: Schema and binding strategy
requirements.acceptance: Positive and negative independent invocation oracles; refusal for unsupported type, overload, loss, drift and invalid arguments; no dynamic arbitrary method execution.

requirements.title: Hierarchical skill and resource generation
requirements.acceptance: Two independent fresh generations byte-identical; reordered source inputs unchanged; all admitted entries reachable exactly once, no duplicate IDs, path traversal, or orphan/stale outputs; check-only mode observational.

requirements.title: Skill selection and token benchmark
requirements.acceptance: Pin models/config/corpus; set acceptance thresholds from measured baseline, test ambiguity, exact vs approximate and cross-domain queries; no optimization by dropping mandatory contracts.

requirements.title: Coverage waves for existing Math APIs
requirements.acceptance: 100% inventory classified, 100% admitted entries reachable and schema/evidence complete; independent representative positive/negative source calls per family and exact identity checks.

requirements.title: Portable net11 package and host boundary
requirements.acceptance: Exact signatures/hashes and locked consumer calls; invalid/tampered fixture refusals; distinguish AgentCallable, BrokerReady, host installation, downstream adoption and publication.

requirements.title: Continuous generation gate
requirements.acceptance: Demonstrate gate on added/removed/changed sample APIs; no manual derived page edits; generator output and admission policy are versioned; separate broker authorization.

requirements.title: Temporal provider and contract admission
requirements.acceptance: Produce ADR and finite oracle corpus for instant vs duration vs period vs local/offset/zoned dates, invalid transitions and provider limits; no provider types leaking into public contracts.

requirements.title: Instants, duration, local/offset dates and intervals
requirements.acceptance: Golden leap, month end, negative duration, exact interval intersection/union/difference, ISO week 53 and overflow examples; no implicit month-as-30-days or local-day-as-24h.

requirements.title: Representation conversions and resolution
requirements.acceptance: Independent epoch, resolution, rounding, Excel phantom day, range and leap-second fixtures; refuse unsupported scales and ambiguous precision; loss recorded.

requirements.title: Versioned time zones
requirements.acceptance: Independent DST 23/25-hour day, folds/gaps, historical and fractional offsets, version-pinned replay, cross-platform behavior; no ambient host-zone dependency.

requirements.title: Calendar systems and recurrence
requirements.acceptance: Leap and end-of-month recurrence, exclusions, interval boundaries, unsupported calendar and unbounded recurrence refusal; no embedded administrative rules.

requirements.title: Academic and fiscal years
requirements.acceptance: Independent synthetic policies with cross-year and nonstandard dates, overlap/gap/refusal, date-to-year and period lookup, teaching counts; no assumptions about an actual university or country.

requirements.title: Financial and time-series calendar bridge
requirements.acceptance: Independent day-count conventions, DST-aware windows and irregular dates; preserve old finance defaults, no new implicit conventions.

requirements.title: Temporal contract and Discovery gate
requirements.acceptance: Run temporal oracle corpus and package-only probes; classify all temporal public APIs, prove generated skill drift-free and record deferred representations/calendars.

requirements.title: Semantic model and source inventory
requirements.acceptance: ADR and finite catalog comparison; same-dimension non-equivalence (energy/torque, Hz/Bq, angle/scalar), absolute vs delta temperature and affine/log conversions explicitly accounted for.

requirements.title: Canonical catalog and conversion policies
requirements.acceptance: Golden exact/approximate unit conversions, inverse/round-trip policy and illegal operations; preserve historical catalog identities; no double counting or invented definitions.

requirements.title: Static quantity types over dynamic core
requirements.acceptance: Independent compile-positive and compile-negative fixtures, runtime bridge dimension/kind refusal, Ohm-law typed example, exact conversions, no duplicate mathematical implementation.

requirements.title: Typed generation, interoperability and catalog gate
requirements.acceptance: Verify generated types and operators are deterministic, no ambiguity for equal dimensions, dynamic/static round-trip and loss policy, stable historical API and qualified selected consumers.

requirements.title: Uncertainty, constants and metrology foundations
requirements.acceptance: Known exact constants and independent propagation fixtures including correlated terms, rounding and invalid covariance; declared uncertainty is not numerical error.

requirements.title: Mechanics and fluids
requirements.acceptance: Dimensional/semantic compile-time and numeric positive/negative oracles, including zero divisions and out-of-domain inputs; no universal physical simulation.

requirements.title: Electricity, electronics and electromagnetism
requirements.acceptance: Independent analytic circuit examples, DC/AC and ideal assumptions, zero/negative/domain refusals, compile-negative kind mismatches; expose qualified law IDs.

requirements.title: Thermodynamics, optics and acoustics
requirements.acceptance: Independent physical-law and unit oracles, absolute/delta temperature, sign conventions, log references and unsupported regime refusals.

requirements.title: Chemical quantities and solution calculations
requirements.acceptance: Mass/mole and concentration oracles, dilution conservation, pH-domain and nonideal-solution refusals; no chemical database ownership assumption.

requirements.title: Stoichiometry and conservation
requirements.acceptance: Atom and charge conservation, known balanced equations, underdetermined/inconsistent and budget refusals; no unsafe experimental or lab procedure claims.

requirements.title: Electrochemistry
requirements.acceptance: Independent analytic fixtures, temperature/charge/stoichiometry units, logarithm domains and zero/equilibrium cases; preserve six historical unit definitions.

requirements.title: Scientific law registry and qualification
requirements.acceptance: Prove all exposed laws have positive/negative oracles, invalid types fail, package-only probes and no unauthorized external adoption; record research/deferrals by family.

requirements.title: Distribution contracts and reproducible sampling
requirements.acceptance: Independent analytic/reference CDF/PDF/quantile and seeded sampling fixtures, support/refusal and tail/overflow tests, historical deterministic vectors unchanged.

requirements.title: Estimation, robust statistics and tests
requirements.acceptance: Known data/reference results, missing/degenerate input and small sample policies, error controls and refusal; no business decision interpretation.

requirements.title: Regression and resampling
requirements.acceptance: Synthetic known-coefficient/fit and resampling oracles, rank separation/convergence failures and numerical tolerances; no model-selection policy ownership.

requirements.title: Streaming and stochastic process extensions
requirements.acceptance: Exact/reference comparison with error guarantees, merge/window/replay tests, invalid probability and budget refusals; preserve M9/M11 contracts.

requirements.title: FFT and signal processing
requirements.acceptance: Compare against direct DFT and analytic fixtures across even/odd/edge lengths, inverse and normalization policies, measured memory/time and explicit bounds.

requirements.title: Irregular time series and seasonal analysis
requirements.acceptance: Independent irregular/DST/missing/duplicate/order cases and analytic series fixtures, deterministic time-zone version context and no hidden imputation.

requirements.title: Statistics and signals gate
requirements.acceptance: Focused + historical M9/M11 oracles, exact/approximate differentiation, classified public APIs and documented provider/algorithm limits.

requirements.title: Precision and provider admission
requirements.acceptance: Record actual availability, rights, version/ABI and independent reference cases; finite scope and explicit deferrals, no broad provider adoption.

requirements.title: Interval arithmetic and directed rounding
requirements.acceptance: Independent exact or high-precision enclosure oracles for endpoints and zero-crossing/refusals; distinguish measurement covariance from numerical enclosure.

requirements.title: Dense/sparse linear algebra
requirements.acceptance: Analytic matrices and independent provider/reference comparison, rank deficiency, ill-conditioning, residual and convergence oracles; no universal solver guarantee.

requirements.title: Tensor operations and accelerated kernels
requirements.acceptance: Independent scalar reference, shape mismatch, aliasing/stride and budget tests, measured allocation and throughput; GPU only by separate scope admission.

requirements.title: Advanced numeric and precision gate
requirements.acceptance: Source/package-only probes, measured deltas, interval containment and precision/refusal evidence, no silent narrowing or publication.

requirements.title: Pure DAG and semantic identity
requirements.acceptance: Independent evaluation graph and equivalence-by-identity fixtures, cycle/budget/domain/refusal and replay tests; no task orchestration or external effects.

requirements.title: Automatic differentiation
requirements.acceptance: Analytic derivative and finite-difference references with tolerances, chain rule and domain/refusal cases; preserve symbolic contracts.

requirements.title: Structured symbolic steps and equivalence
requirements.acceptance: Independent substitutions/counterexamples, domain-loss refusals, canonical IR and historical symbolics oracles; no general theorem prover or universal CAS.

requirements.title: PlotModel and geometry
requirements.acceptance: Golden analytic plots and discontinuities/asymptotes, invalid sampling domains and finite budgets; no UI rendering ownership.

requirements.title: Bounded examples and educational integration
requirements.acceptance: Independent exact/negative example oracles, deterministic replay and documented unsupported proof claims; no curriculum or pedagogical policy.

requirements.title: Computation and representation gate
requirements.acceptance: Verify actual supported operations, no lost domains, portable codecs, reproducibility and explicitly deferred formal proof scope.

requirements.acceptance: Every accepted requirement maps to exact durable evidence or an explicit approved scope decision, no fabricated readiness or unsupported domain claim.
